# Raptor

> Raptor is a configurable RV32/RV64 superscalar, out-of-order RISC-V processor.
> These docs cover the core, simulation, Linux boot, platform integration, and verification scope.

Each link below serves the complete page as Markdown. For an HTML documentation
URL ending in .html, append .md; the homepage's Markdown URL is index.md.
GitHub Pages serves static files and does not negotiate Markdown using the Accept header.
